The sunset painted the sky in hues of deep orange and soft pink, with streaks of purple stretching across the horizon. The sun, a glowing orb, dipped slowly below the skyline, its light reflecting off the glass facades of towering skyscrapers, creating a dazzling display of shimmering gold and amber. The city, bathed in this warm glow, seemed to pause, as if time itself was stretching lazily into the evening. As the last rays faded, the first stars began to twinkle above, and the city lights slowly came to life, transforming the daytime bustle into a serene, golden-hued twilight.
